sloka: एवमेव महावीर्यो हतो नस्तातमध्यमः।न तु सत्पुरुषा राजन् विलपन्ति यथा भवान् ।। ६.६९.२ ।।
transliteration: evameva mahāvīryo hato nastātamadhyamaḥ।na tu satpuruṣā rājan vilapanti yathā bhavān ।। 6.69.2 ।।

translations.english: "There is no doubt that Kumbhakarna, who is your middle father and uncle, was also endowed with great prowess. He has been killed. O King! Good men like you do not wail."
